objective: Bring Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.

description: Ilkrud Magthrull. Yes, I have knowledge of him. He is a powerful orc warlock that makes his residence at the Fire Scar Shrine,  a place of great evil in southwestern Ashenvale.
He had been little more than an annoyance until now, and I had not dealt with him, but it seems that his time has come.
progress: You look a bit shaken up, <name>. Are you well?
completion: It was a grand thing you did today, <name>. You should be quite proud of yourself for having faced down a warlock of such power.
Now, let's see what we can learn from Ilkrud's writings.
